name: dev-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt for /orchestrate-spec, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time. Forked from savvy-progress.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: workflow: when a dev-workflow agent starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts
